title: Build operational Filter Presets admin
description: Replace the Filter Presets architecture graph with a practical WordPress admin tool for reusable filter definitions.
objective: Let implementers create, edit, duplicate, and delete filter presets that Elementor widgets can consume.
expected_outputs: Filter Presets list with create/edit/delete actions.
Operational preset form with provider, target, apply mode, URL, sort, pagination, and filter rows.
State-changing actions protected by capability checks and nonces.
acceptance_criteria: A new preset can be saved through the admin form and appears in FilterPresets::options().
An existing preset can be edited without changing its option data shape.
Deleting a preset requires a nonce and manage_options capability.
The form supports the current filter types: search, checkbox, radio, select, chips, toggle, range, date, swatch, and rating.
verification: Run PHP lint on changed admin and support files.
Run WP-CLI smoke to render list and edit states.
Run WP-CLI save/delete smoke against FilterPresets data shape if practical.
TASK-012 validated successfully with MCP validate_task.
PHP lint passed for changed admin/support files through Docker WP-CLI runtime.
WP-CLI render smoke returned filters:rendered:clean-copy and filters_new:rendered:clean-copy:nonce.
WP-CLI option contract smoke returned filter_save:ok.
Playwright captured filter-presets.png and filter-preset-form.png with no page-level horizontal overflow.

budgets.context_budget: FilterPresets storage contract and Elementor widget preset mapping
budgets.scope_budget: admin CRUD for existing preset contract only
budgets.validation_budget: lint, render smoke, option shape smoke

risks: Expanding filter semantics can break widget rendering; this task must only expose the existing contract.
Large dynamic builders can become another UI rabbit hole; fixed operational rows are acceptable for this batch.
